subject: Salus Health — MAP kickoff: goals, owners, 8-week timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thompson <claire@salushealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff — Salus Health evaluation (proposed goals & 8-week plan)

Hi Claire and Monica,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — excited to get the evaluation moving. I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan to align on goals, owners, and an 8-week timeline that will get Salus to a pilot-ready evaluation. Attached is a lightweight MAP template (MAP_template_v1.xlsx) we can iterate on.

Proposed primary goals (please confirm):
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost at 99th pct under your typical clinical workloads
- Verify data handling and KMS integration for PHI-adjacent logs
- Run a pilot inference flow integrated with your staging environment and evaluate quality/regression metrics

Proposed timeline (8 weeks):
Week 0: Kickoff, confirm stakeholders & SOW items
Week 1–2: Access provisioning, security questionnaire, initial baseline runs
Week 3–4: Model tuning, KV cache config, run sample workload
Week 5: Performance/quality sync, address regressions
Week 6–7: Pilot run in staging, cost/latency analysis
Week 8: Decision meeting (pilot outcome -> pilot or stop)

Owners (suggested):
- Salus champion: Claire Thompson (product) — decision owner
- Salus technical lead: Priya Rao (eng) — infra & data access
- Redwood AE: Karthik Iyer — program owner / commercial coordination
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole — onboarding & runbooks
- Redwood PM: Monica Patel — MAP facilitator, weekly status

Ask: Can you confirm the goals above, add any internal stakeholders (e.g., security, compliance), and confirm if the 8-week cadence looks feasible? Also send 2x 30–45m slots you and Priya have this week for a 1st kickoff.

I attached the MAP template — happy to switch to your format if you have one.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Salus Health evaluation (proposed goals & 8-week plan)

Hi Karthik (and Monica),

Thanks — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. Priya (cc'd below) will be the technical lead. I'm adding Tom Ellis from security so he can scope the SOC2 questions early.

Confirmed goals: latency/cost and pilot-run - priority order as listed. The 8-week plan looks reasonable; my only ask is that we add a hard checkpoint at week 3 to decide whether to iterate the model tuning approach or switch to the quantized runtime you mentioned.

Available for kickoff (ET):
- Tue 23 Sep 2025, 11:00–11:45am
- Wed 24 Sep 2025, 2:00–2:45pm

I'll share a short internal doc with success criteria for the pilot (analytics, acceptable token cost, and latency targets). Also note: procurement will need an initial pricing estimate and SOW stub to start internal approvals — happy to receive that after week 1.

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — Salus Health evaluation (proposed goals & 8-week plan)

Claire / Karthik / Priya — thanks for the quick replies and for looping security. I can take the MAP facilitator role and will own the weekly status and the shared tracking doc. I've attached a short Redwood security summary for Tom to review (redwood-security-summary.pdf) and published a shared MAP folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_Map_Salus_Kickoff

Confirming the kickoff: Tue 23 Sep 2025, 11:00am ET (I blocked 45m). Agenda (proposed):
- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Access & provisioning plan (10m)
- Initial performance baseline & sample dataset (10m)
- Risks, blockers, and week-1 deliverables (10m)
- AOB & next steps (5m)

Week-3 checkpoint is a good call — we'll put the decision gate on the MAP under "Model tuning vs quantized runtime". For procurement, Karthik — if you can share an initial pricing estimate + SOW stub after our kickoff, Claire says procurement will start internal approvals.

Action items before kickoff:
- Claire / Priya: add any additional stakeholders to the Drive folder and paste success criteria doc (Claire)
- Tom: scan the attached security summary and flag requirements that need evidence before week 2
- Karthik: prepare a one-page pricing estimate and SOW stub (we'll capture in the MAP)
- Marissa: prep onboarding checklist & runbook sample for Week 1

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Monica
